hints.title: Precompute Substring Palindromes
hints.text: Precompute a 2D boolean table is_pal[i][j] indicating whether substring s[i..j] is a palindrome.

hints.title: Two Boundary Cuts
hints.text: A valid three-part split requires cut indices i and j such that s[0..i-1], s[i..j-1], and s[j..n-1] are all palindromes.

hints.title: Enumerate Split Pairs
hints.text: Iterate over all valid cut points 1 <= i < j < n; if all three pieces are palindromes, return true immediately.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s (<= 2000)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all 3-way partitions and verifying palindromes naively takes O(n^3) cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputed palindrome table reduces verification of cuts to O(1) lookups in O(n^2) total time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate precomputes substring palindromes dynamically in O(n^2) before checking cut pairs.
